expansion.modernize: Repair stale code, scripts, workflows, tests, runners, CI/CD, contracts, and diagnostics.
expansion.innovate: Create new useful node/edge/atom/graph connections, alternate viewpoints, dependencies, hierarchy, and orchestration patterns.
expansion.perpetuate: Put improvements in motion through repeatable runners, Docker, DMAIC-style loops, metrics, history, PR progression, and self-heal receipts.

lanes.victory: Repo census generated with denominators, runtime surfaces, branch/SHA, dirty state, and candidate backlog.
Debug and observability candidates are classified by signal and next action.
Docker, runner, CI, MCP, and orchestration surfaces are separated into present, missing, and suspicious.
Stale, duplicate, TODO, health, and self-heal candidates are visible without behavior-changing automation.
At least one reusable core skill or agent/orchestrator candidate is selected for packaging.
